items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: There had been a version of it by Orlando Robeson with one of the bands. ... I never heard it. Probably Orlando Robeson got the idea to do it, or the band, and ... Orlando Robeson had done it. He sang 'Trees' with Chick Webb's band (sic) and they recorded that. But I just never did record it.

ctx.x: that just about winds it up as far as Pittsburgh is concerned, except I would like to ask you one more thing. That is, you mentioned a couple of songs early on during these interviews which you sang, you mentioned Brown Bird Singing and Trees.
Yeah, well Trees was a very popular song that I did. There had been a version of it by Orlando Robeson with one of the bands.
